This consultation seeks views on the government’s proposals to extend the regulations until 2032 and the design of years 3 to 6 of the scheme, including:

  • heat pump credit targets
  • the award of credits for heat pump installations in new build properties
  • continuing current scheme mechanics such as the carry-over of credits, carry-forward of targets and the payment-in-lieu
  • continuing the exclusion of air-to-air heat pumps, heat batteries and heat interface units
  • introducing support through credits for investment in UK and/or sustainable manufacturing

Read our consultation privacy notice.
